description: List stores in the ShelfAtlas catalog. Filter by chain slug, or pass lat/lng for a nearest-first geo search (optionally capped by radius_km; geo results are not paginated).

chain_slug.description: Chain slug, e.g. "rema". Omit for all chains.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response (ignored for geo search).

radius_km.description: Only stores within this many km (requires lat/lng).

name: get_stores
